name: 3D Tools
description: Installs 3D simulation and modeling tools (Blender and Godot) from verified official releases for headless scripting, rendering, and project workflows.

installBlender.description: Install official Blender release for headless scripting, rendering, and extension development (x86_64 only).

blenderVersion.description: Blender release: 'latest', a series such as '4.5' or '5.3', or an exact MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH >= 4.2.0.

installGodot.description: Install official Godot editor release for headless project workflows.

godotVersion.description: Godot stable release: 'latest', or MAJOR.MINOR / MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH >= 4.2.2 (optionally with '-stable').

godotVariant.description: Godot build variant: 'standard' (GDScript) or 'dotnet' (C# / .NET; pair with a .NET SDK feature).
